stem: Tanya walks through a reserve with dense herbs, shrubs and trees. Birds, insects and deer live there and find food and shelter.

statements.text: Forests are large areas with dense growth of various plants and are natural homes for many wild animals, including birds and insects.
Forests provide food and shelter to the animals that live there.
This reserve is a forest home for many life forms only because the plants look green.

teacher.key_rationale: A forest is more than a group of trees: dense varied plants form a home that provides food and shelter for many animals, including birds and insects. Looking green alone does not make the reserve a forest home.
